title: NYC C.R.E.D. v2 extraction envelope
description: The closed schema every extraction.json validates against before semantic QC. Loaded at assembly and by the schema gate. Unknown keys, aliases, JSON nulls, blank strings, and out-of-enum values fail the gate and leave semantic checks NOT_REACHED.

function_sweep_ledger.description: Eleven rows per supplied page plus the DOCUMENT_SUPPORT completion row per page.

bundle_manifest.description: Build-tool emitted. A hand-authored manifest fails the gate.

names.description: Exactly one PRIMARY_AS_WRITTEN. A related company is never a name variant.

party_attribute.description: Closed oneOf. There is no catch-all member: a new semantic class extends the schema rather than passing closure silently.

index_coverage_qa.description: Capability is adapter-declared per attribute. An attribute outside the set is always NOT_CHECKABLE, never a silent pass.

party_relationship.description: Directional stated edges only. Never merges identities; registry membership is not operative status.

participation.description: Role, capacity and share are event properties. Share is absent unless words establish a share slot.

resolves_claim_ids.description: The candidate claims this event answers. FR-COV-005 matches on these.

observation_unplaced.description: No date-shaped key may appear in this lane.

registration_annotation.description: A registry-side note. v2 has no clock for it; that gap is recorded rather than filled.

tests.description: All three tests are exhaustive and each names what it checked.

boundary_orphan.description: Claim-level. A SUPPORT_ONLY disposition resolving claim A cannot resolve excluded claim B.

checks.description: Exactly eleven records in FR-QC-001..011 order. Duplicates cannot validate.

reference_components.description: D-9 splits a locator into visibly present components only; absent forms are omitted, never invented.

raw_registration.description: The exact supplied registration JSON, archived verbatim. Deliberately unconstrained: it is the input, not an output shape.

ledger_row.description: A sweep cell flattened into the extraction with its pass identity.

index_reported_value.description: An index report retains referent UNKNOWN until image evidence proves it.

recording_identity.description: Components of the CURRENT recording. Never an external reference.
